clearCoverCache.title: Clear all cached covers?
clearCoverCache.message:
This will delete {{count}} cached images ({{size}}).

Cover images will be re-downloaded as needed when browsing. This may temporarily slow down performance.

cleanMetadataCache.title: Clean up metadata cache?
cleanMetadataCache.message:
This will remove browsing cache older than 90 days.

Favourited manga and manga with downloads will not be affected.

Estimated to remove: {{count}} manga

clearAllMetadata.title: Clear all metadata cache?
clearAllMetadata.message:
This will remove ALL browsing cache ({{count}} manga).

Only favourited manga and manga with downloads will be kept.

This action cannot be undone.

deleteOldLogs.title: Cleanup old logs?
deleteOldLogs.message: This will permanently delete all log files older than {{days}} days. This action cannot be undone.

clearAllLogs.title: Clear all logs?
clearAllLogs.message: This will permanently delete all log files. This action cannot be undone.

deleteRestorePoint.title: Delete this restore point?
deleteRestorePoint.message: This restore point will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

restoreToPoint.title: Restore to this point?
restoreToPoint.message: This will replace your current library and settings with the state saved at this restore point, then restart DexReader. Anything added or changed since then will be lost. This action cannot be undone.

clearAllOverrides.title: Clear all custom reading settings?

openFailure.title: Database problem
openFailure.detail: The database file appears to be corrupted and can't be opened. Choosing "Back up & reset" moves the broken file aside (it is not deleted) and starts a fresh, empty database. Your library and reading history won't be restored automatically — re-import from a backup afterwards if you have one.

recoveryFailure.title: Database problem
recoveryFailure.message: DexReader still couldn't recover its database.
recoveryFailure.detail: Please reinstall the app, or contact support with the log files from the app data folder.

migrationFailure.title: Update problem
migrationFailure.message: DexReader couldn't update its database for this version.
migrationFailure.detail: This is a bug in this release, not a problem with your data — your library and reading history are untouched. Copy the diagnostic details to report it, and consider installing the previous release until a fix is out.
